# Home Crafts by Ali

> > A creative lifestyle blog by Aliza featuring DIY craft tutorials, homemade recipes, and home decor projects for everyday crafting and cooking inspiration.

Home Crafts by Ali is a personal creative blog showcasing handmade projects, seasonal decorations, and kitchen recipes. The site combines DIY tutorials with cooking content, featuring popular recipes like Instant Pot meals and side dishes, alongside craft projects using accessible materials from retailers like Dollar Tree and Walmart.

## Recipe Collections

- [Recipes](http://homecraftsbyali.com/p/recipes.html): Main recipes collection page with main meals, sides, desserts, and soups by Aliza
- [Side Dishes](https://www.homecraftsbyali.com/p/side-dishes.html): Side dishes recipe collection including Oven Roasted Ranch Potatoes
- [Soups and Salads](https://www.homecraftsbyali.com/p/soups-and-salad.html): Soups and salads recipe collection for comfort food and homemade cooking
- [Must Try Instant Pot Recipes](https://www.homecraftsbyali.com/2020/02/must-try-instant-pot-recipes.html): Roundup of easy Instant Pot recipes for breakfast, soups, and weeknight meals
- [Tomato Pie](https://www.homecraftsbyali.com/2018/09/tomato-pie.html): Southern tomato pie recipe with fresh ingredients and flaky crust for brunch

## DIY Craft Tutorials

- [Double Heart String Art Tutorial](https://www.homecraftsbyali.com/2020/02/double-heart-string-art-tutorial.html): Step-by-step string art tutorial for making double heart home decor pieces
- [Easy DIY Decor Broomsticks](https://www.homecraftsbyali.com/2018/10/easy-diy-decor-broomsticks.html): Step-by-step tutorial for making DIY fall and Halloween decorative broomsticks
- [Patriotic Wreath](https://www.homecraftsbyali.com/2015/05/patriotic-wreath.html): Step-by-step tutorial for making red, white, and blue patriotic wreaths
- [Easy to Make Paper Bookmark](https://www.homecraftsbyali.com/2019/01/easy-to-make-paper-bookmark.html): Tutorial for making quick and easy paper bookmarks from scrapbook paper
